name: Fasting with purpose
promise: Five days on why to fast, how to fast and how to fast wisely.
why: For believers who want to fast but are unsure of the reason or the right way. The path follows Jesus into the wilderness, explains what fasting does to the flesh and the spirit, gives practical guidance with limits, and ends with fasting as part of a temperate, disciplined life.

days.theme: Why Jesus fasted before the test
days.key_quote: When Jesus said fasting and prayer, he meant the environment should not influence you, but you must influence environment.
Don't leave your life to chance. Don't leave your destiny to chance. Build capacity.

days.theme: Fast wisely and within safe limits
days.key_quote: Fasting doesn't change God; fasting actually changes you.
If you set your face, it means you have decided to ignore what is behind you.
The requirement for expertise in the things of the Spirit is that you must master every appetite.
